ServiceDescriptor.description: A legacy service descriptor, the way otoroshi 17 and older described a service. Its main fields are described here, the other ones (headers, security, client settings, canary, plugins, ...) are read the way otoroshi 17 wrote them. Every field is optional: the template of a new descriptor gives the missing ones

id.description: The id of the descriptor, kept as the id of the route

name.description: The name of the descriptor, given to the converted route

description.description: The description of the descriptor, given to the converted route

groups.description: The ids of the service groups of the descriptor

items.description: The id of a service group

env.description: The environment of the descriptor, part of its legacy domain (`<subdomain>.<env>.<domain>`, without the env when it is `prod`)

domain.description: The domain of the legacy domain of the descriptor

subdomain.description: The subdomain of the legacy domain of the descriptor

hosts.description: The hosts the descriptor matches, besides the legacy domain built from `subdomain`, `env` and `domain` (unless `handleLegacyDomain` is false). Each host, followed by each of the `paths` (by `matchingRoot`, or `/`, when there is none), becomes a domain of the converted route

paths.description: The path prefixes the descriptor matches on each of its hosts. Each of them, after each host, becomes a domain of the converted route

matchingRoot.description: The path prefix the descriptor matches, removed from the forwarded path

stripPath.description: Whether the matched path is removed from the forwarded path

root.description: The path prefix of the calls forwarded to the targets

targets.description: The targets the calls are forwarded to

items.description: A target of the descriptor. Its other fields (protocol, predicate, ip address, mtls configuration, backup, ...) are read the way otoroshi 17 wrote them

host.description: The host of the target, with its port if any

scheme.description: The scheme of the target, `https` by default

weight.description: The weight of the target in the load balancing, 1 by default

publicPatterns.description: The regular expressions of the paths that need no api key

privatePatterns.description: The regular expressions of the paths that need an api key even when they match a public pattern

forceHttps.description: Whether http calls are redirected to https

metadata.description: Free key/value pairs attached to the descriptor, given to the converted route along with the `otoroshi-core-` keys that keep its legacy settings (`otoroshi-core-legacy`, `otoroshi-core-env`...)

tags.description: Free tags of the descriptor, given to the converted route with an `env:<env>` tag added
